title: Lifting Operation Permit (Enhanced)
description: Free Lifting Operation Permit (Enhanced) template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit information, work details, hazard identification.

Precaution Measures Checklist

Precaution require to complete the work safelyYesNoN/ARemarks
Is the lifting equipment certified by accredited center? Does certification comply with SEC list? Is the operator certified and hold valid license (KSA) for this activity? Operator Name: ______________ License No: ______________ Expiry: _______ Are all accessories inspected (rigging arrangements)? Checked items:
☐ Wire Rope Sling ☐ Web Sling ☐ Chain Sling ☐ Shackles ☐ Eye Bolt ☐ Other: _____ Is Load Chart checked and applicable? Is the Load within Crane capability at the given radius of operation? Required Capacity: _____ tons @ _____ m radius | Available Capacity: _____ tons Is the rigger certified for this load limit? Name of Rigger: ______________ Rigger Level: _____ Valid Until: _______ Is a Signalman/Banksman appointed? Is wind speed acceptable to proceed the activity? (stop if >32km/h or dusty wind) Is the ground condition suitable and verified? Are outriggers fully extended and properly set on pads? Are outrigger pads/mats of adequate size? Is the crane level (checked with spirit level)? Are there any overhead power lines in the vicinity? If yes, is safe distance maintained as per voltage? Is the swing radius barricaded? Are tag lines provided for load control? Is the load weight verified? Are lifting points on load verified? Is communication system tested and working (radios/hand signals)? Emergency Rescue team and equipment (tower erection) in place?		☐
